title: Tel Aviv Museum of Art
geometryBasis: Three mapped building polygons provide the current massing controls, including 39 points for the main building and 9 for the independently named Amir addition.
sectionBasis: The original terrain anchors the higher main entrance and falls toward the Amir wing. Main facade details follow the exact 2005 photograph. The Amir concept and material are drawn from the primary written sources.
limitations: Main building roof elevations, part of the 2018–2019 building update, bay dimensions and the northern structure’s detail are estimates.
Amir facade folds, panel spacing and sectional heights are representative geometry based on the measured site and architect’s written description.
The separate Eyal Ofer Pavilion, freestanding sculpture, museum interiors and neighboring civic institutions are outside this site.
